plan.goal: 测试兑换计算器：切换法币和加密货币、查看汇率图表的不同时间范围
tasks: Open the entry page /convert/usd-to-btc and record the displayed USD to BTC exchange rate.
Enter a test amount in the amount input and verify the converted BTC value updates accordingly.
Open the from-currency selector, choose a different fiat currency, and confirm the displayed pair and rate refresh.
Open the to-currency selector, choose a different cryptocurrency, and confirm the displayed pair and rate refresh.
Return the from and to selectors to USD and BTC to restore the baseline pair.
Click the 1h time range tab on the price chart and confirm the chart renders and the range label updates.
Click the 1W time range tab and confirm the chart changes to the weekly view.
Click the 1M time range tab and confirm the chart changes to the monthly view.
Click the 1Y time range tab and confirm the chart changes to the yearly view.
Verify the exchange rate display remains consistent with the selected currency pair and entered amount after all changes.
